pages.title: Caught Some Timber
pages.text: Fish up a native fishing crate and open it.

pages.title: Caught Some Timber
pages.text: Open contextual loot through real fishing.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The catch context selects the available crate and its loot. One kind is enough; a crafted or gifted crate does not prove fishing it up.

pages.title: Retrieve contextual fishing crates
pages.text: A real catch can yield a context-specific crate with its own loot. Configuration determines luck and selection weight; crafting a crate does not prove fishing one up.

pages.title: Read fishing conditions
pages.text: The watch shows time, Lunar Calendar shows moon phase, Depth Meter shows depth, Weather Radio forecasts weather and Fish Finder shows fishing context. Climate Gauge reports biome temperature without weather or seasonal adjustments.
